title: Best TMG Supplement | Strength & Longevity in 2026
abstract: ProHealth’s NMN Pro Complete supplement provides 1g of each ingredient listed above, which is either within or approximate to clinical ranges for longevity outcomes.37 40 The 500mg of TMG is lower, and a fraction of NOW’s dose, but also in line with amounts used in clinical studies to lower homocysteine levels.41 So, with NMN Pro Complete, you have an effectively dosed trifecta of well-studied ingredients that can both extend your life expectancy and improve your quality of life. The best-supported uses of TMG supplements are for improving cardiovascular health,25 26 9 physical strength performance,27 30 and cellular fluid balance (the last of these may help counteract heat stress and skin aging).23 24 It also acts as an excellent methyl donor in the NAD+ production process.42 Clinical research supports TMG use to support liver health, but with higher doses than you should take.32 Some people claim that it can help with cognitive health and weight loss, but there’s no credible evidence at this time to support those claims.
